title: lavandula latifolia var. vulgaris
intro: Lavandula latifolia var. vulgaris, commonly known as Spike Lavender, is a subspecies of the Lavandula latifolia plant, which is native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce anxiety and promote relaxation, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of menopause and menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of Spike Lavender include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and relieve muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include linalool, linalyl acetate, and camphor, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and contribute to its distinct, pungent aroma.
